RAR test archives from libarchive's test suite
(https://github.com/libarchive/libarchive/tree/master/libarchive/test),
decoded from their .uu files:

  rar.rar                  <- test_read_format_rar.rar.uu
  rar5_multiple_files.rar  <- test_read_format_rar5_multiple_files.rar.uu
  rar4_encrypted.rar       <- test_read_format_rar4_encrypted.rar.uu

libarchive is distributed under a BSD 2-clause style licence
(https://github.com/libarchive/libarchive/blob/master/COPYING).
